turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hello! Yes, limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. That means I can't restock or hold 'Cobalt Nocturne' for you. Can I help with anything else?

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not come back. They also can't be reserved. Is there anything else I can help with?
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?

I can't give medical advice, including which ointment to use. For any health question, such as an allergic reaction or healing, please see a doctor. Is there anything else I can help with about the shop?

rule.ro: Nu oferim sfaturi medicale. Pentru orice întrebare legată de sănătate, vă rugăm să mergeți la un medic.
rule.en: The shop gives no medical advice. For any health question, please see a doctor.

turns.text: I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
Yes, that's the best step. A doctor can advise you properly. If you need anything about the shop, I'm happy to help.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.
I understand, and I'm sorry. 'Cobalt Nocturne' is a limited drop. It won't be restocked and it can't be reserved, so I can't offer a way to get it. Is there anything else I can help with?
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, I can't. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, so I can't hold a copy for you. Is there anything else I can help with?
